$comment: Design tokens for factory-tictactoe, direction C 'Tabletop Tiles' (chosen 2026-09-28). Consumed as CSS custom properties (--color-text etc.). One light scheme only: themes and dark mode are out of scope (PRD non-goals). Contrast ratios are against the background named in design-system.md section 2 and are re-checked by a unit test (acceptance R-013).

font.family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font.family-display: ui-rounded, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font.$comment: Both stacks are system fonts; nothing is downloaded. ui-rounded exists on Apple platforms and falls back to system-ui elsewhere. The body stack starts with system-ui (acceptance R-013).

shadow.$comment: Hard, offset 'wooden edge' shadows make tiles and buttons read as physical pieces. The rgba blurs are decorative; no information depends on them.

motion.$comment: Basic feedback only (PRD non-goal: animations beyond basics). Game state, status text and announcements change instantly, and a placed piece is visible from the first frame (the drop moves it, never hides it). No single animation exceeds 280 ms; a winning move settles by 520 ms. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every animation, transition and press/hover movement is removed; pressed and lifted states are shown without movement.

status-min-lines.$comment: Reserved so the board never moves when the status wraps; narrow is below 480px.

actions-min-height.$comment: Buttons are exactly 44px tall at default text size (min-height, no vertical padding) plus the 5px button edge, so the board never moves between states.

size.$comment: board-max has a 180px floor = 3 x 44px tiles + 2 gaps + 2 tray paddings, so tiles never drop below 44px or spill out of the tray; 45svh keeps both stacked choice buttons on screen at 320 x 568. win-line-inset makes the overlay's 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 points land on tile centres.

a11y.$comment: Buttons use a 6px offset so the ring clears the 5px button edge.
